subject: A gentle invitation to your next class
preheader: Beginner-friendly movement, at your own pace.

content.text: A LITTLE SPACE IN YOUR WEEK
You don’t have to arrive calm.
Just arrive. We’ll make a little room to move, breathe and begin again.

attrs.alt: A terracotta yoga mat and folded linen in a softly lit blush-colored studio.

content.text: A practice that meets you here.
Some days you want to stretch. Some days you want to sit quietly. Our small-group classes leave room for both, with guidance you can adapt to your own body.
Gentle movement and an unhurried pace.
An accessible place to start asking questions.
A quieter class for the end of a full week.
Come as you are. Take what you need.
